v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: system shall accept list of existing calendar events
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: system shall compute all possible meeting start times
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: system shall only suggest meeting start times within working hours
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: system shall return all valid meeting start times in order

v1_human_g3_goal: The systems objective is to suggest possible meeting time slots available during the day. It has constraints to make sure there are valid times within work hours, doesn't conflict with other events, and alternative response if no time available.
v1_human_g3_input:
1) events: its type is a list of dictionaries of the type List[Dict[str,str]]. its format is events = [{"start": "09:00", "end": "11:00"}]
2) meeting_duration: it is an integer to represent minutes. Its type is int. Its format is meeting_duration = 30
3) day: it is a string to represent the day. Its type is str. Its format: day = "2024-02-01"

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: meeting shall not suggest meeting times that overlap
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: meeting shall not suggest meeting times during lunch break

v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: The scenario where it has the least chance of the room being booked, or the room that has no upcoming bookings for the day.
